incident_text: Part of a five-storey apartment building has collapsed. Dust covers the street and neighbours say some residents may still be inside.

result.scene_summary: A collapsed building with extensive structural damage is surrounded by debris, with partially intact buildings and vegetation visible in the background.

observations.description: A multi-story building is heavily damaged, with its roof and upper floors collapsed, revealing interior rooms and shattered walls.
A tall pole stands near the debris pile. Partially intact buildings are visible in the background.
A tree with green foliage is visible behind the debris pile.
Debris includes broken bricks, wooden beams, and metal sheets scattered around the base of the collapsed structure.
A large white sack is resting on a low concrete structure in the foreground.
In the far background, a few people are visible, appearing small and distant near other buildings.
